Title: Page loads on Step 1 of 7 with all seven steps in the stepper
Description: Verify the registration wizard opens on the first step
Test steps: 1. Open https://recruitment.zcmc.online/register
Expected results: The heading 'Applicant Registration', 'Step 1 of 7' and '14% Completed' are shown. The stepper lists Profile, Address, Education, Eligibility, Experience, References and IPCR

Title: Step 1 shows all personal information fields
Description: Verify the personal information fields are displayed
Test steps:
1. Open the registration page
2. Look at Personal Information
Expected results: First Name, Middle Name, Last Name, Name Extension (optional), Sex, Date of Birth, Civil Status and Place of Birth are shown

Title: Step 1 shows demographics and account fields
Description: Verify the demographic and account fields are displayed
Test steps:
1. Open the registration page
2. Scroll to Demographics & Background and Account Credentials & Contact
Expected results: Blood Type, Religion, Sexual Orientation, Specific Membership, Ethnicity, Citizenship, Mobile Phone Number, Email Address and Password are shown

Title: Empty Step 1 cannot proceed to Step 2
Test steps:
1. Open the registration page
2. Leave all fields empty
3. Click Next Step
Expected results: The form stays on Step 1 of 7 and the empty required fields are flagged

Title: Invalid email format is rejected
Test steps:
1. Open the registration page
2. Type 'not-an-email' in the Email Address field
3. Click Next Step
Expected results: The email is flagged as invalid and the form does not proceed

Title: Password field hides the typed characters
Test steps:
1. Open the registration page
2. Type in the Password field
Expected results: The characters are masked

Title: Already registered Login link opens the login page
Description: Verify the Login link on the registration page
Test steps:
1. Open the registration page
2. Click 'Login' next to 'Already registered?'
Expected results: The login page (/login) opens

Title: Sync UMIS Account option is shown for ZCMC employees
Test steps:
1. Open the registration page
2. Scroll to the bottom
Expected results: The text 'Currently employed in ZCMC?' and the link 'Click here to sync UMIS Account' are shown

Title: Dropdown options are loaded
Description: Verify the registration dropdowns have options
Test steps:
1. Open the registration page
2. Click the Sex dropdown
3. Repeat for Civil Status, Blood Type, Religion, Sexual Orientation, Specific Membership and Ethnicity
Expected results: Each dropdown lists selectable options
Notes: Playwright: register.spec.ts. The dropdown data was empty earlier (/api/selection-templates returned []) and is loaded now. Sex: Male/Female. Civil Status: Single/Married/Divorced/Widowed. Blood Type: A+ to O- plus Unknown/Not Sure

Title: Applicant completes Step 1 and proceeds to Step 2
Test steps:
1. Open the registration page
2. Fill in all required Step 1 fields with test data (email from a Mailinator inbox)
3. Select an option in every dropdown
4. Click Next Step
Expected results: Step 2 of 7 opens
Notes: Playwright: register.spec.ts. Fills Step 1 only and clicks Next Step. Middle Name is required. TC-REG-011 to TC-REG-034 cover Steps 2 to 7 and the final submit

Title: Step 2 shows the residential and permanent address fields
Description: Verify the address fields are displayed
Test steps:
1. Complete Step 1 and click Next Step
2. Look at Step 2
Expected results: Step 2 of 7 'Address Details' (29% Completed) shows Residential Address and Permanent Address. Each has House / Block / Lot No.; Street; Subdivision / Village (optional); City / Municipality; Barangay; Province; Zip Code and Telephone / Contact No.

Title: Empty Step 2 cannot proceed to Step 3
Description: Verify required-field validation on the address step
Test steps:
1. Complete Step 1 and open Step 2
2. Leave all fields empty
3. Click Next Step
Expected results: The form stays on Step 2 of 7 and the empty required fields are flagged

Title: Choosing a city loads the barangays and fills Province and Zip Code
Test steps:
1. Open Step 2
2. In City / Municipality type 'Zamboanga City' and select 'Zamboanga City (Zamboanga Del Sur)'
3. Open the Barangay list
Expected results: Province shows 'Zamboanga Del Sur' and Zip Code shows 7000 automatically. The Barangay list loads (first item 'Arena Blanco') and was disabled until a city was chosen

Title: Same as residential address copies and locks the permanent address
Description: Verify the 'Same as residential address' checkbox
Test steps:
1. Fill in the Residential Address on Step 2
2. Tick 'Same as residential address'
Expected results: Every Permanent Address field shows the residential values and is disabled. Unticking the box makes them editable again
Notes: Playwright: register.spec.ts. Unticking is to be confirmed

Title: Back keeps the data entered on the previous step
Description: Verify no data is lost when going back
Test steps:
1. Complete Step 1 and open Step 2
2. Click Back
Expected results: Step 1 of 7 opens and all the Step 1 values are still filled in

Title: Step 3 starts empty and Add Education Entry shows the education fields

1. Complete Steps 1 and 2 and open Step 3
2. Click 'Add Education Entry'
Expected results: Step 3 of 7 (43% Completed) shows 'No educational entries added yet'. After clicking, Education Entry #1 shows Education Level (Elementary, Secondary, Vocational/Trade Course, College, Graduate Studies), School / Institution Name, Degree / Course, Year From, Year To and Honors / Distinction Received (optional)
Notes: Playwright: register.spec.ts. A toast reads 'Please complete your educational background.'

Title: Empty education entry cannot proceed

3. Leave the entry empty
4. Click Next Step
Expected results: The form stays on Step 3 of 7 and the required fields are flagged
Notes: Playwright: register.spec.ts. To confirm whether Next Step also blocks when no entry is added at all

3. Select Year To 2021
4. Click Next Step

Notes: Playwright: register.spec.ts. Observed: the Year To list offers years earlier than Year From. Expected behavior is to confirm

Title: An education entry can be removed
Description: Verify the delete button on an entry
Test steps:
1. Open Step 3
2. Click 'Add Education Entry'
3. Click the red delete button on Education Entry #1
Expected results: The entry disappears and 'No educational entries added yet' is shown again
Notes: Playwright: register.spec.ts. The same delete button exists on Eligibility

Expected results: Step 6 of 7 (86% Completed) 'Character References' shows 'No character references added yet'. After clicking, Reference #1 shows Full Name, Position / Title, Email Address, Contact Number, Relationship Type (Supervisor, Subordinate, Peer) and Office / Work Address

Title: Step 7 shows the IPCR rating field and it can be left blank
Test steps:
1. Open Step 7
2. Leave the rating empty
Expected results: Step 7 of 7 (100% Completed) shows 'Latest IPCR Numerical Rating (1.00 - 5.00)' and the hint that it can be left empty if the applicant never worked in a government agency. The Finish Registration button is shown

Test steps:
1. Open Step 7
2. Type 0.5 and click Finish Registration
3. Type 5.5 and click Finish Registration
Expected results: Both values are rejected and the Registration Prompt does not open

Title: Progress bar and stepper follow the current step
Test steps:
1. Complete the steps one at a time
2. Check the percentage and the stepper after each Next Step
Expected results: The progress shows 14%, 29%, 43%, 57%, 71%, 86% and 100% for Steps 1 to 7. Finished steps show a check mark in the stepper

Title: Finish Registration opens the Registration Prompt
Test steps:
1. Complete Steps 1 to 7
2. Click Finish Registration
3. Click Next on each tab
Expected results: The 'Registration Prompt' dialog opens with the tabs Credentials, Security and Recovery. The last tab has the button 'I Understand, Continue'. Cancel closes it without submitting
Notes: Playwright: register.spec.ts. Does not create an account if the dialog is cancelled

Title: Legal Affirmation requires the sworn statement before finalizing
Test steps:
1. Click 'I Understand, Continue' in the Registration Prompt
2. Look at the Confirm & Finalize button
3. Choose a verification channel
4. Tick 'I swear that all information provided is true, accurate, and complete.'
Expected results: The dialog warns about a permanent lifetime ban. Confirm & Finalize is disabled until the box is ticked. Email Address is selected by default and Mobile Number can be chosen instead
Notes: Playwright: register.spec.ts. Cancel closes the dialog without submitting

Test steps:
1. Tick the sworn statement
2. Click Confirm & Finalize
Expected results: The page opens /verify and asks the applicant to verify the email address
Actual results: The page moved to /verify, which is completely blank. No text, form or buttons are shown, also after a reload
Notes: Seen manually on 2026-11-20 with Email Address as the channel. Needs a developer to check. Playwright: register.spec.ts (full-registration group)
